applyTo.name: Use acorn dice for
applyTo.hint: "Every d6, for everyone" shows every d6 of every roll as an acorn, whatever the game system. "Each player's choice" only adds Acorn Dice to the Dice So Nice settings, where each player can pick it.
applyTo.player: Each player's choice (Dice So Nice settings)
